name: SPICE label-efficient molecular potentials
description: acquire(unlabeled_geometries, observations, budget)->unused indices; fit(observations)->object with potential(atomic_numbers, coordinates_angstrom)->(energy_ev, forces_ev_angstrom). Eight precomputed quantum-label queries from12 source acquisition geometries in the bounded pilot;14 evaluation geometries hold out entire ligand groups. Score force RMSE/(1 eV/Angstrom) + molecule-centered relative-energy RMSE/(1 eV) on source-group holdouts. Independent finite differences check force/energy consistency, rigid-motion symmetries, net force/torque; short evaluator-controlled trajectories check numerical stability. All units are explicit and a test fixture never substitutes for SPICE.

Official source generation scripts and units.

limitations: Independent SCIEL adaptation of a cited scientific problem; no claim to reproduce author leaderboard scores.
Candidate and evaluator run in one Python process; data access is separated by API, not an OS sandbox. Isolate evaluator data for adversarial or held-out evaluation.
Bounded eight-query interaction-complex pilot:12 training geometries and14 evaluation geometries, entire ligand groups held out. Not full SPICE training or leaderboard reproduction.
Retrieved HDF5 ranges and normalized bundle are SHA256-pinned; full37.5GB source-file checksum was not verified. Unit conversions are verified against HDF5 units.

science_relevance.scientific_problem: Learn molecular energies and forces with limited expensive quantum-chemical labels.
science_relevance.importance_rationale: Accurate molecular potentials can make physically informed molecular simulation less costly.
science_relevance.reason: SPICE is a dataset paper. The inspected active-learning ANI study (Less is more: sampling chemical space with active learning) pursues transferable molecular potentials, but the current eight-query pilot has only twelve acquisition and fourteen evaluation geometries. This review did not establish that this restricted pilot preserves that substantive research objective rather than primarily testing an acquisition interface; no transferable-potential result follows from the pilot. No qualifying primary-goal evidence is established for this local task in this review; this is not a finding that the broader subject is unimportant.
science_relevance.verification_basis: Local task contract and cited source purpose reviewed; background or benchmark citations were not promoted to primary-problem evidence.
